dependencies.name: Expat
dependencies.finding: The exact release changelog records fixes for CVE-2026-66046, CVE-2026-76641, CVE-2026-76957, and CVE-2026-76956.

dependencies.name: zlib
dependencies.finding: The upstream releases page identifies 1.3.2 as the latest published release and states that it addresses findings from a security audit; the upstream GitHub security page listed no published advisories at review time.

dependencies.name: LZ4
dependencies.finding: The upstream releases page identifies 1.10.0 as the latest published release and the upstream GitHub security page listed no published advisories. Open upstream issue 1783 concerns the deprecated unsafe LZ4_decompress_fast API; mmxisf uses LZ4_decompress_safe and does not call that API.

dependencies.name: Zstandard
dependencies.finding: The upstream releases page identifies 1.5.7 as the latest published release and the upstream GitHub security page listed no published advisories. mmxisf uses the core ZSTD_decompressDCtx and ZSTD_compress APIs, not the contributed seekable format.

dependencies.name: OpenSSL
dependencies.finding: OpenSSL identifies 3.6.4 as a security patch release. Its vulnerability list marks the reviewed issues as affecting 3.6 releases before 3.6.4.

limitations: This review is bound to an unfrozen development snapshot and does not satisfy the mandatory exact frozen-candidate audit.
The review covers the five direct binary dependencies recorded in the provider SBOM; it is not a complete operating-system or build-toolchain vulnerability audit.
An upstream page showing no published advisories does not prove that no unpublished or newly disclosed vulnerability exists.
The official-source review must be repeated immediately before any tag or binary publication and after every dependency or toolchain change.
The macOS provider is ad-hoc signed and not notarized; this review does not authorize publication.
